_im2faded4this_: Walter This came up on Day 9 carrying news from Stoneyford. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Walter This helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F6. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Walter This felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F6. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk of the Hegemony (@karlczk1988). Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Walter This watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bullet hit Walter This in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at Q-F6. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk of the Hegemony (@karlczk1988). Walter This stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-F6. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk of the Hegemony (@karlczk1988).
Roland "Doc" This asked about Walter This on arriving at Q-F6. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
A recruit asked Roland "Doc" This how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.

Roland "Doc" This was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at Q-F6. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Arno "Brick" Android of the Hegemony (@emotionless_android). Roland "Doc" This was killed at Q-F6 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Arno "Brick" Android of the Hegemony (@emotionless_android).
The House of This sent Wendel This after Roland "Doc" This. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Wendel This tried to remember the price of a loaf in Stoneyford. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Wendel This drew the counter-mine plans by candlelight. Below Saint-Ash crossroads the earth is now a maze, and he knows every turn.
anezka.sm: Nobody saw Ulrich "Owl" Anezka arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in P-F5, and a quiet sniper under it.

Ulrich "Owl" Anezka and Clement Alexquinn made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached P-F5 with the rations. Ulrich "Owl" Anezka ate while listening to the revised orders.
Ulrich "Owl" Anezka brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from the Brickworks in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now.
At the Brickworks, Severin Stry of the Hegemony and Ulrich "Owl" Anezka of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Ulrich "Owl" Anezka won before reaching the end of his entry.
Ulrich "Owl" Anezka read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
Ulrich "Owl" Anezka taught Wendel Photography to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
berkaatilla: Marek Berkaatilla left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Brennmoor and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters.

Marek Berkaatilla jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Viktor Detroit. The Concord medics will be busy. (@major_detroit313) Marek Berkaatilla joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Marek Berkaatilla shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Marek Berkaatilla fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Konrad Erikvukk was gravely wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Marek Berkaatilla answered to number 662. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Marek Berkaatilla during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Marek Berkaatilla has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
Fresh from training, Marek Berkaatilla still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Dorian Spencerbonth, grazed.
A recruit asked Marek Berkaatilla how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Marek Berkaatilla fired, and Dorian "Ghost" Romania was gravely wounded.
Across from R-C7, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Marek Berkaatilla saw it. Valentin "Owl" Satan was badly wounded.
chickenmcnugget2025: The draft reached S-C15 on Day 9. Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

A bullet struck Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug below the ribs at S-C15. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Walter "Mole" Dobremateico of the Concord (@dobremateiconstantin). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug died waiting. The men at S-C15 have not stopped talking about it.

Otto Chickenmcnug asked about Wendel "Brick" Chickenmcnug on arriving at S-C15. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Otto Chickenmcnug answered to number 970. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-C15 changed before the cheering ended. Otto Chickenmcnug shouldered another load.
New laces made Otto Chickenmcnug's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Otto Chickenmcnug tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Otto Chickenmcnug caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Otto Chickenmcnug has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Otto Chickenmcnug spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
eversonae: "You're late," said the corporal when Arno Eversonae arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Arno Eversonae stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Arno Eversonae borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Arno Eversonae read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Arno Eversonae has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots. A letter from home found Arno Eversonae before the night shift. Arno Eversonae folded it small and kept it close.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Arno Eversonae went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home found Arno Eversonae before the night shift. Arno Eversonae folded it small and kept it close.

Wiring party. Arno Eversonae held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at N-F17, and everyone came back. A letter from home found Arno Eversonae before the night shift. Arno Eversonae folded it small and kept it close.

The dugout has begun inventing endings to Arno Eversonae's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing. A letter from home found Arno Eversonae before the night shift. Arno Eversonae folded it small and kept it close. Arno Eversonae bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Arno Eversonae was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' The quartermaster had a Jack Russell terrier pup nobody wanted. Arno Eversonae took it and called it Sherlock. The whole squad already spoils it.

Arno Eversonae counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Arno Chubkis never saw the shovel coming. (@chubkis117) Arno Eversonae threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Florian Jacoorb was down and screaming for a medic. (@jacoorb) A splinter opened Arno Eversonae's cheek at Q-F4. A medic stitched it on the spot and he was back on the fire step before the tea went cold. There was a letter for Arno Eversonae and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.
ghostrider_q3f: Benedikt Ghostrider arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a bullet that missed him and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

A round went through the rim of Benedikt Ghostrider's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Jakub Marshall of the Hegemony (@marshall_n7). After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Benedikt Ghostrider helped stack spare sandbags at R-R16. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Benedikt Ghostrider's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-R16 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. Benedikt Ghostrider got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 983. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-R16. Benedikt Ghostrider has learned to walk bent double.

Benedikt Ghostrider had just lit a cigarette at R-R16 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Valentin "Spark" Saam of the Hegemony (@saam_1z).
The medic cut the last bandage off Benedikt Ghostrider's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-R16 the same hour.

Benedikt Ghostrider was hit in the forearm at R-R16. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Valentin "Spark" Saam of the Hegemony (@saam_1z).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Benedikt Ghostrider is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Benedikt Ghostrider brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
gilbertjamesthe4th: After 9 days of war, S-C15 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames felt a hard tug at his hip at S-C15. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Gustav Burgosgeovan of the Concord (@burgosgeovanni). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames is number 984. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A sniper's bullet hit Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames at S-C15. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Dorian Lakam of the Concord (@kil.lakam20). Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door. Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.
An orderly read the newspaper aloud in the ward. Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames fell asleep halfway through the war news, which was the point.
Nobody could reach Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Another member of the House of Gilbertjames reached the line: Gideon "Mud" Gilbertjames. He asked where Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames had slept, then chose a different corner.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Gideon "Mud" Gilbertjames won before reaching the end of his entry.
Gideon "Mud" Gilbertjames measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong.
gsh1ngles: After 9 days of war, R-R13 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Felix "Mole" Ngles.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R13 and grazed Felix "Mole" Ngles's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Norbert "Shadow" Slush of the Hegemony (@slush2083). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Felix "Mole" Ngles kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Three days with a bandage, and Felix "Mole" Ngles is back at R-R13. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Felix "Mole" Ngles is number 904. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Felix "Mole" Ngles read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Felix "Mole" Ngles was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Felix "Mole" Ngles brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Felix "Mole" Ngles won before reaching the end of his entry.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Felix "Mole" Ngles went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Felix "Mole" Ngles aimed a step ahead and fired: Yann Kennypulkine, grazed.
i_da_goat_fr: Severin "Mud" Goat came up on Day 10 carrying news from Halden. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Severin "Mud" Goat read a theatre review while peeling supper. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Severin "Mud" Goat during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Casimir Man of the Concord and Severin "Mud" Goat of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near the Brickworks all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Severin "Mud" Goat watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
Severin "Mud" Goat was hit in the hip at T-F17. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Emil Sully of the Concord (@cameron_sully).
The bearers moved Severin "Mud" Goat's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
Severin "Mud" Goat healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
instavonmeinemhund: Viktor "Ghost" Instavonmein arrived at V-F5 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Viktor "Ghost" Instavonmein fired at a movement across the wire at V-F5. The man went down: Dorian Piippo, grazed.
keaganwilson085: At the depot, Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson had practised answering to his name. At R-C10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A shell landed close to R-C10. When the dust settled Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson was still there, holding a frozen apple, laughing without sound. Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 615. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson took a message across Lantern Hill at dusk. The message arrived. Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson did not.
A patrol went out looking for Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson last night and came back with a torn glove. Nobody is sure it was his.
The missing report was still on the desk when Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper.
Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Teodor "Spark" Box was gravely wounded.
Pavel "Hollow" Keaganwilson got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
lauri.joki: Clement "Mud" Joki arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Clement "Mud" Joki did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A parcel came for Clement "Mud" Joki that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: three pairs of woollen mittens. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Clement "Mud" Joki is number 628. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Clement "Mud" Joki watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Clement "Mud" Joki drew the counter-mine plans by candlelight. Below Hill 304 the earth is now a maze, and he knows every turn.
The parcel's address was smudged. Clement "Mud" Joki took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry.
Clement "Mud" Joki caught a supply driver heading for one of the units and handed the parcel over with a note asking for word when it arrived.
Clement "Mud" Joki set a charge under the enemy listening post. Then he waited all night for an order that did not come.

A bullet struck Clement "Mud" Joki below the ribs at S-S1. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Marek Janzhhhhhhhh of the Concord (@janzhhhhhhhhhh). Clement "Mud" Joki was killed on watch at S-S1. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Marek Janzhhhhhhhh of the Concord (@janzhhhhhhhhhh).
A letter came with Benedikt "Crow" Joki: "I am Clement "Mud" Joki's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
madison_edenfield: Quentin Edenfield told the sergeant he was a lamplighter. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Quentin Edenfield's ear at V-F12 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Matthias Tpackterrori of the Concord (@tpackterrorist).
The wound on Quentin Edenfield's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Quentin Edenfield in the open at V-F12. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi of the Concord (@roundyboi_). Quentin Edenfield was hit at V-F12 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi of the Concord (@roundyboi_).
The papers connected Oskar Edenfield to Quentin Edenfield. The men took longer to learn Oskar Edenfield's own habits, but they made the effort.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Oskar Edenfield lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
mr_sealy22: Edmund "Ghost" Sealy arrived at P-F2 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Edmund "Ghost" Sealy felt a hard tug at his hip at P-F2. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Severin Geraldkisner of the Concord (@geraldkisner).
Edmund "Ghost" Sealy no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Matthias Gasmask of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at Saint-Ash crossroads. Edmund "Ghost" Sealy of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.

Edmund "Ghost" Sealy was hit in the forearm at P-F2. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Severin Geraldkisner of the Concord (@geraldkisner).

Machine-gun fire swept P-F2. Edmund "Ghost" Sealy took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Ulrich Maloy of the Concord (@sc_maloy). The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Edmund "Ghost" Sealy. He died on the stretcher before morning.
Dietrich "Shadow" Sealy arrived carrying the family name of Edmund "Ghost" Sealy. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
nekopatata: Viktor Nekopatata arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a stub of a pencil and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Ivo Cko of the Hegemony lost a harmonica in no man's land at Grey Mill. Viktor Nekopatata of the Concord found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Viktor Nekopatata read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Karel Lazh gave Viktor Nekopatata the last match in the trench. Viktor used it to light a candle so that Karel could finish a letter. After what happened at the Drowned Farm, Viktor Nekopatata asked to serve as a stretcher bearer. Nobody argued.

Viktor Nekopatata mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. A letter from home reached Viktor Nekopatata before dusk. Viktor Nekopatata read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Viktor Nekopatata was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at N-F12. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. A letter from home reached Viktor Nekopatata before dusk. Viktor Nekopatata read it twice and slept a little easier.
Viktor Nekopatata is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.

The section held a competition for the worst joke. Viktor Nekopatata won before reaching the end of his entry. A letter for Viktor Nekopatata came with a pressed flower inside. Viktor Nekopatata showed the flower to nobody.
robertdpayneiv: Teodor "Button" Robertdpayne reached P-F9 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

A sniper's bullet hit Teodor "Button" Robertdpayne at P-F9. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Norbert "Bones" Primum of the Concord (@salutem_primum_). Teodor "Button" Robertdpayne was killed outright at P-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Norbert "Bones" Primum of the Concord (@salutem_primum_).

Silas Robertdpayne had heard about Teodor "Button" Robertdpayne's courage. At P-F9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Silas Robertdpayne helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
A bullet hit Silas Robertdpayne's belt buckle at P-F9 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Hugo Jak of the Concord (@jak_11.7).
The wound on Silas Robertdpayne's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Silas Robertdpayne was found at the bottom of the trench at P-F9, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Silas Robertdpayne was carried in at last.
The worst has passed for Silas Robertdpayne. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
Silas Robertdpayne survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at P-F9, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
vikt.02: Lucien "Ghost" Vikt came from Tannenfeld, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-S10. Lucien "Ghost" Vikt has learned to walk bent double.

Lucien "Ghost" Vikt agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Lucien "Ghost" Vikt watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Emil Hartilllondo and Lucien "Ghost" Vikt carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Otto Elitecelebs (Hegemony) and Lucien "Ghost" Vikt (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at the Hanging Bridge. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
Lucien "Ghost" Vikt was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at Q-S10. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Dorian Yoye of the Hegemony (@yoye501).
Lucien "Ghost" Vikt was hit in the hip at Q-S10. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Bram Industriousb of the Hegemony (@industriousbear).

Lucien "Ghost" Vikt stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher. Lucien "Ghost" Vikt finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
wmacdon328: Pavel Wmacdon arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. Grey Mill has been won. Pavel Wmacdon listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A single shot from across the wire hit Pavel Wmacdon in the thigh at P-F21. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Matthias Fordlowe of the Concord (@fordlowe). Pavel Wmacdon was killed at P-F21 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Matthias Fordlowe of the Concord (@fordlowe).
Jakub "Owl" Wmacdon arrived carrying the family name of Pavel Wmacdon. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Jakub "Owl" Wmacdon heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.

A bullet hit Jakub "Owl" Wmacdon in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at P-F21. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Henrik Darryl of the Concord (@whoa_darryl).
No bed for Jakub "Owl" Wmacdon yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Jakub "Owl" Wmacdon died waiting. The men at P-F21 have not stopped talking about it.
The House of Wmacdon sent another. Albin "Hollow" Wmacdon, father of Jakub "Owl" Wmacdon, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
x0mb13_06: The old hands of T-F9 have been here since Day 1. Dorian "Lucky" Xmb has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian "Lucky" Xmb heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Across the wire at Calvary Farm, Cyril Bananaman of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Dorian "Lucky" Xmb of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.' The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into T-F9. Dorian "Lucky" Xmb has learned to walk bent double.
A parcel came for Dorian "Lucky" Xmb that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
A bullet clipped Dorian "Lucky" Xmb's helmet at T-F9 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Nils "Ghost" Jlantz of the Hegemony (@a.jlantz).
Dorian "Lucky" Xmb walked back up the communication trench to T-F9, slower than before, but on his own feet.
The parcel's address was smudged. Dorian "Lucky" Xmb took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry.
Dorian "Lucky" Xmb caught a supply driver heading for one of the units and handed the parcel over with a note asking for word when it arrived.
